editorial.blurb: bb.q Chicken Chicago Chinatown serves some of the city's best Korean fried chicken—crispy, tender, and never greasy—with bold sauces that keep people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Original Korean Fried Chicken for the purest, most flavorful experience, and ask for sauces like soy garlic and honey garlic on the side if you want to keep the coating extra crispy.
